author: Mark Atwood
text:
Landed option (b) on Person/CheckItem/Checklist/Comment with per-type serde-default functions returning the literal type name. Bare `String` shape preserved; deserialize is now liberal (defaults to type-name) and serialize always emits the field.

**Partial divergence from bead recommendation (deliberate)**: bead said 'apply uniformly across all four sub-types and the Task type itself'. Did NOT change Task.at_type — it stays at `Option<String>` with `skip_serializing_if`. Rationale: Task is a top-level JMAP /get response shape and per the doc comment on Task (task.rs lines 169-172) all Task fields are Option for RFC 8620 §5.1 partial-response correctness. The sibling jmap-calendars-types CalendarEvent.at_type uses the identical `Option<String> + skip_serializing_if` pattern (crate-jmap-calendars-types/src/event.rs:117). Aligning Task to bare String would diverge from CalendarEvent and break partial-response semantics that may rely on omitting `@type` when not requested.

Workspace policy reference: jscalendar-types AGENTS.md fixes the bare-String shape for JSCalendar sub-types (RFC 8984 marks every @type as mandatory); jscontact-types AGENTS.md fixes Option<String> for jscontact (RFC 9553 §1.3.4 allows defaultType omission); top-level JMAP objects (Task, CalendarEvent) use Option<String> for partial-response reasons. The four landed sub-types align with the jscalendar-types convention (mandatory @type, bare String shape with liberal-deserialize via serde default).

Regression tests added in crate-jmap-tasks-types/tests/types_test.rs:
- person_at_type_defaults_when_absent
- check_item_at_type_defaults_when_absent
- checklist_at_type_defaults_when_absent
- comment_at_type_defaults_when_absent
- person_at_type_explicit_value_round_trips_verbatim (locks in: serde default does NOT overwrite an explicit wire value, so AcmeCorpPerson round-trips verbatim)
- task_with_check_items_missing_at_type_deserializes (locks in: the concrete failure-mode the bead identified — a Task containing CheckItems without @type now deserializes successfully)

Independent oracle: hand-written JSON shaped against draft-tasks-06 §4.2.3/§4.2.4 with @type omitted, plus the produced serialize-back JSON checked against the same draft's mandated string.

Quality gates: jmap-tasks-types 73 tests pass (was 67), cargo fmt clean, cargo clippy -p jmap-tasks-types --all-targets -D warnings clean, RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings cargo doc -p jmap-tasks-types --no-deps clean. Downstream consumers (jmap-tasks-server, jmap-tasks-client, jmap-testjig) tests still pass. Pre-existing workspace-wide clippy errors in jmap-mail-types/src/mdn.rs:757-758 and a doc_lazy_continuation lint are out of scope and not touched.

Workspace propagation follow-up filed as bd:JMAP-ky8g.10 (P2) for the 12+ JSCalendar sub-types in jmap-jscalendar-types and any analogous sites in jmap-calendars-types.
